title: Investigation of gene expression changes in normal human dermal fibroblasts after exposure to bone marrow mesenchymal stromal cell secretome
primary_or_cell_line: primary commercial NHDF; donor lot count unverified
treatment: sEV versus DMEM vehicle; other secretome fractions separate
biological_replicates: 8 culture libraries/arm across two batches; independent donor n NA
notes: Control GSM7988505-8508 and GSM7988517-8520; sEV GSM7988509-8512 and GSM7988521-8524; batch balanced; same commercial NHDF lot may limit donor generalization.
validation_rationale: Same recipient species/tissue and bulk RNA-seq with eight libraries per arm; EV producer and 48-h duration differ; no wound-fate contrast.

title: Fibroblast Growth Factor-2 bound to specific dermal fibroblasts-derived extracellular vesicles is protected from degradation: relevance to wound healing
recipient_cell: primary dermal fibroblasts; two donor lines
EV_source: human dermal fibroblasts; unstimulated or FGF2-stimulated
treatment: PBS versus control EV versus FGF2 EV versus soluble FGF2; antibody pretreatments also present
dose: 2E+10 EV particles/sample for reported RNA-seq arms
sample_count: 16 total; four core groups x two donor lines plus pretreatment arms
notes: Core comparison must distinguish control EV vs PBS from FGF2 EV vs control EV; the latter measures cargo/context differences. GEO title has suffix absent from published article title.
validation_rationale: Same primary dermal recipient and EV perturbation, but two donor lines, 24-h exposure, distinct EV producer/cargo, and raw-count reconstruction from SRA needed.

title: The influence of melanoma extracellular vesicles on benign melanocytes, dermal fibroblasts and microvascular endothelial cells (part1)
EV_type: EV-containing or putative EV-enriched conditioned medium; isolated EV-only not established
treatment: concentrated A375 melanoma conditioned medium versus untreated primary fibroblasts; GSM calls it EV treatment
exclusion_reason: GSM protocol says recipients were incubated with collected concentrated A375 conditioned medium for 72 h; an isolated-EV-only RNA-seq contrast is not established.
notes: Sample protocol explicitly says PM/PF/EN incubated with collected conditioned medium for 72 h after 100-kDa ultrafiltration; this supersedes the GSM characteristic label EV treatment. Raw count matrix and 3/arm still available for a different question.
validation_rationale: The 100-kDa ultrafiltration treatment remains conditioned medium; other retained components could cause the response, so it cannot isolate EV effects.

title: The cellular response to extracellular vesicles is dependent on their cell source and dose
recipient_cell: primary human dermal fibroblast strain GM08402
treatment: three EV doses versus untreated and storage-buffer controls
sample_count: NA; paper reports 10 controls and triplicates per EV type-dose
biological_replicates: triplicate cultures; one recipient donor strain
exclusion_reason: Required HUVEC/control sample-to-count-column mapping not verified from accessible metadata; Dryad README file returned 403 at discovery.
notes: Scientifically attractive endothelial EV source; not counted as eligible until raw-count columns and control mapping are verified. Dryad file human_CSR_raw_count.txt is 26.6 MB and was not downloaded.
validation_rationale: Potentially source-matched HUVEC arm and primary dermal fibroblast, but one recipient donor, 24-h exposure, and unverified sample-to-column map block immediate selection.

title: The transcriptome profile of the stomach fibroblasts with high-metastatic or low-metastatic gastric cancer cell-derived extracellular vesicles
primary_or_cell_line: patient-derived then immortalized with mutant Cdk4; cyclin D1; hTERT
EV_source: gastric cancer cell lines 44As3 and HSC-44PE
treatment: two EV sources versus PBS or untreated controls
gene_identifier: Agilent probe IDs; mapping to genes needed
notes: Related GSE116167 referenced in later paper; inspect sample provenance before treating it as additional independent study.
validation_rationale: EV-exposed human fibroblasts but immortalized gastric cancer context and microarray platform are distant from EXP001.

title: Human bronchial epithelial cell-derived extracellular vesicles attenuate pulmonary fibrosis through inhibiting TGF-beta-WNT crosstalk [RNA-Seq]
EV_source: human bronchial epithelial cells; BEAS-2B cells
treatment: EV versus PBS at 24 h and 48 h
notes: GSE158624 is a SuperSeries containing GSE158623 RNA-seq and GSE156572 EV miRNA; count only one study. No biological replication within RNA-seq contrasts.
validation_rationale: Primary human fibroblasts and EV perturbation, but lung tissue, different producer, and n=1 per condition-time preclude robust gene-level validation.

title: Exosomal miR-194 from adipose-derived stem cells impedes hypertrophic scar formation through targeting TGF-beta1 [miRNA]
notes: Mixed tissue, rabbit, and miRNA readout; not a primary fibroblast mRNA replication.
validation_rationale: Public EV-treated wound tissue with control but different species, mixed cells, and miRNA rather than recipient mRNA.

title: Mesenchymal stem cell-derived small extracellular vesicles promoting M2 macrophage polarization through p38 MAPK inhibition
treatment: LPS then 30 ug/mL MSC-sEV for 48 h versus LPS-only; untreated also present
biological_replicates: n=3 per group stated by deposit
exclusion_reason: Recipient is rat macrophage (Tier C biology), and sample-to-file mapping/file availability were not visible in deposit metadata.
notes: Cannot promote to primary fibroblast validation; confirmation of listed public files would permit Tier C cross-context only.
validation_rationale: Different species and macrophage recipient; even if files resolve, can only test distant EV response.

title: Single cell RNA-seq analyses of dermis from wound day 18 large skin wounds that healed in a fibrotic or regenerative fashion.
treatment: regenerative versus fibrotic wounds; no EV exposure
biological_replicates: each library pooled from multiple wounds; no independent replicate library
exclusion_reason: No EV perturbation; reference context only, not EV replication.
notes: L10 C3.5 paper is reanalysis of these same samples; not a new independent dataset.

title: scGeneScope: A Perturbationally-Paired Single Cell Imaging and Transcriptomics Dataset and Benchmark for Treatment Response Modeling
exclusion_reason: No EV exposure and no fibroblast recipient; methods resource only.

title: Small RNA sequencing of small extracellular vesicles derived from senescent vs. nonsenescent human dermal fibroblasts (HDFs)
exclusion_reason: Profiles cargo in fibroblast-produced EVs; no EV-treated recipient fibroblast transcriptome.

title: Extracellular Vesicles (Secretomes) from Human Trophoblasts Promote the Regeneration of Skin Fibroblasts
EV_type: exosomes and conditioned medium tested separately
treatment: RNA-seq was scratch-wounded fibroblasts treated with trophoblast conditioned medium
omics_type: bulk RNA-seq described for conditioned medium arm
exclusion_reason: Sequenced perturbation is trophoblast conditioned medium, not isolated exosomes; no EV-only RNA-seq comparator verified.
notes: Functional EV assays do not make the RNA-seq an EV-specific contrast.

title: The role of Endothelial cell-derived Extracellular Vesicles in modulating Fibroblast Function in Skin Wound Healing
exclusion_reason: EXP001 source dataset itself; cannot independently validate its own findings.
notes: GEO and BioProject are the same six biological samples, counted once.

title: Extracellular Vesicles From Liver Progenitor Cells Downregulates Fibroblast Metabolic Activity and Increase the Expression of Immune-Response Related Molecules
treatment: EV versus untreated/control described in paper
omics_type: transcriptomic profiling; exact GEO platform unverified
exclusion_reason: Mouse 3T3-L1 is at most Tier C; GEO sample-level comparator map not verified in this pass.
notes: Publisher article links GSE157022, but indexing did not yield authoritative series/sample metadata.
